Dog mess on paths ends up on wheelchair wheels.

That means bringing it straight into your home. Floors, carpets, hands.

It is not just unpleasant. It is a hygiene and accessibility issue.

If you have a dog, scoop the poop. 💜

#Accessibility #Community
